post.name: fdo-copy-ssh-host-keys
post.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Runs in the Agama live system (chroot: false); the target is mounted at /mnt.
# Copy the SSH host keys generated during FDO onboarding (and already
# registered with the owner via fdo.credentials) onto the target.
set -e
if [ ! -d /run/fdo/ssh-host-keys ]; then
    echo "FDO: /run/fdo/ssh-host-keys not found" >&2
    exit 1
fi
cp -a /run/fdo/ssh-host-keys/ssh_host_* /mnt/etc/ssh/
echo "FDO: copied SSH host keys to /mnt/etc/ssh"

post.name: fdo-harden
post.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Runs inside the installed system (chroot: true).
set -e
# Ownership, modes and SELinux labels for the copied host keys. sshd-gen-keys-start
# (ssh-keygen -A) only creates missing keys, so these survive first boot.
chown root:root /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*
chmod 0600 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key
chmod 0644 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub

# Onboarding key for the fdo user (Agama 16.0 has no user.sshPublicKey yet)
install -d -m 0700 /home/fdo/.ssh
echo "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIECb1b7JjbIThvin1gum8LH5ctWoCCKGuUsyAQoa3ko3 fdo-onboarding" > /home/fdo/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /home/fdo/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown -R fdo: /home/fdo/.ssh

# fdo user: passwordless sudo
echo "fdo ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/90-fdo-user
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/90-fdo-user

# Key-only SSH
printf 'PasswordAuthentication no\nKbdInteractiveAuthentication no\n' > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-fdo.conf
chmod 0600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-fdo.conf
systemctl enable sshd.service
if command -v firewall-offline-cmd >/dev/null; then
    firewall-offline-cmd --add-service=ssh || true
fi

# SELinux is enforcing on Leap 16: label everything written from outside the policy
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null; then
    restorecon -Rv /etc/ssh /etc/sudoers.d /home/fdo/.ssh
fi

# Agama copies the installer's kernel parameters into the installed bootloader
# config. Drop the installer-only ones: memmap= would permanently reserve the
# ISO-sized RAM region as a fake pmem disk; nokaslr and systemd.unit are not wanted.
if [ -f /etc/default/grub ]; then
    sed -i -E '/^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT=/{s/ ?memmap=[^ "]*//g; s/ ?nokaslr//g; s/ ?systemd\.unit=[^ "]*//g; s/="  */="/}' /etc/default/grub
    grep '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT=' /etc/default/grub
    update-bootloader --refresh || grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg
fi

# Mark installation complete
mkdir -p /var/lib
echo FDO_AUTOINSTALL_COMPLETE > /var/lib/fdo-autoinstall-complete
